item.title: Sciwind Biosciences Partners with Pfizer China to Commercialize its Biased GLP-1 in China
item.description: HANGZHOU, China, Feb. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hangzhou Sciwind Biosciences Co., Ltd. ("Sciwind Biosciences") today announced a strategic commercialization collaboration with Pfizer China for Ecnoglutide injection (Ecnoglutide), a new–generation cAMP–biased GLP–1 receptor agonist. Under the agreement, Pfizer will obtain exclusive commercialization rights for the product in Mainland China, marking an important first step to advance Pfizer's global strategy in the metabolic field in China.
